ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 40% high-intensity pixels and 60% low-intensity pixels across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity (white) zone on the distal portion of the right lobe; high-intensity strip along the lateral edge of the left lobe. Low-intensity (black) pigmentation dominates the central and proximal areas, punctuated by high-frequency white stippling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped median notch with an acute interior angle visible at the fluke centerline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations extracted along the entire trailing edge boundary; right lobe displays more pronounced irregular peaks and valleys than the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Overall convex sweep on both lobes, significantly disrupted by jagged trailing edge irregularities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of numerous circular high-intensity pixel clusters (scars) concentrated in the lower-central region and scattered across both lobes' dark surfaces.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Parallel, vertically-oriented linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) detected on the upper trailing edge of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular serration and potential tissue loss along trailing edges; vertical rake marks on the distal right lobe; extensive mottling across central dark zones.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive 'salt-and-pepper' texture created by white speckling against the dark central pigmentation.
